name: PluginToolset.PluginToolset
description: Tools for creating, editing, enabling, and querying Unreal plugins

tools.description: Validates that PluginName and RelativePluginLocation are acceptable for a new plugin.
tools.name: PluginToolset.PluginToolset.ValidateNewPluginNameAndLocation

relativePluginLocation.description: Parent directory for the new plugin relative to template's default location. This should be empty unless you wish to specify a subdirectory.

bPlaceInEngine.description: Use Engine Plugins directory rather than Game Plugins directory location. Only some Templates allow placing in Engine. See the TemplateInfo's bCanBePlacedInEngine. This should be false unless explicitly requested by the user.

templateInfo.title: PluginTemplateDescriptionToolsetInfo
templateInfo.description: The plugin template to potentially create from.

name.description: Name of this template in the GUI

description.description: Description of this template in the GUI

onDiskPath.description: Path to the directory containing template files.

defaultTemplateName.description: Default plugin name. Typically a prefix.

bCanBePlacedInEngine.description: Whether or not this template can be used for Engine plugins

returnValue.description: True if the name and location are valid.

tools.description:
Updates a plugin's descriptor fields and writes them to its .uplugin file.
Checks out the file via source control if source control is enabled.
No-ops if the serialized descriptor is unchanged (file is not touched).
tools.name: PluginToolset.PluginToolset.UpdatePluginDescriptor

pluginName.description: The name of the plugin to update.

newDescriptor.title: PluginDescriptorToolsetInfo
newDescriptor.description: The new descriptor field values to apply.

category.description: The name of the category this plugin belongs to.

versionName.description:
Name of the version for this plugin. This is the front-facing part of the version number. It doesn't need to
match the version number numerically, but should be updated when the version number is increased accordingly.

version.description:
Version number for the plugin. The version number must increase with every version of the plugin, so that the
system can determine whether one version of a plugin is newer than another, or to enforce other requirements.
This version number is not displayed in front-facing UI. Use the VersionName for that.

createdBy.description: The company or individual who created this plugin. This is an optional field that may be displayed in the user interface.

createdByURL.description: Hyperlink URL string for the company or individual who created this plugin. This is optional.

marketplaceURL.description: Marketplace URL for this plugin. This URL will be embedded into projects that enable this plugin, so we can redirect to the marketplace if a user doesn't have it installed.

bIsBetaVersion.description: Marks the plugin as beta in the UI.

bIsExperimentalVersion.description: Marks the plugin as experimental in the UI.

bIsSealed.description: Prevents other plugins from depending on this plugin.

tools.description: Enables or disables a plugin in the project config. The change takes effect on the next editor restart.
tools.name: PluginToolset.PluginToolset.SetPluginEnabled

bEnabled.description: True to enable, false to disable.

tools.description: Removes a dependency entry from a plugin's Plugins array in its .uplugin file.
tools.name: PluginToolset.PluginToolset.RemovePluginDependency

pluginName.description: The name of the plugin to modify.

dependencyName.description: The name of the dependency to remove.

tools.description: Lists the names of all enabled plugins, sorted alphabetically.
tools.name: PluginToolset.PluginToolset.ListEnabledPlugins

returnValue.description: Sorted array of enabled plugin names.

tools.description: Lists the names of all discovered plugins (enabled and disabled), sorted alphabetically.
tools.name: PluginToolset.PluginToolset.ListDiscoveredPlugins

returnValue.description: Sorted array of discovered plugin names.

tools.description: Checks whether the editor settings permit modifying plugins from the plugin browser.
tools.name: PluginToolset.PluginToolset.IsPluginModificationAllowed

returnValue.description: True if plugin modification is allowed, false if it is disabled in Editor Settings.

tools.description: Checks whether the editor settings permit plugin creation from the plugin browser.
tools.name: PluginToolset.PluginToolset.IsPluginCreationAllowed

returnValue.description: True if plugin creation is allowed, false if it is disabled in Editor Settings.

tools.description: Checks whether a discovered plugin is currently enabled.
tools.name: PluginToolset.PluginToolset.IsEnabled

returnValue.description: True if the plugin is enabled, false if it is disabled.

tools.description:
Returns the list of available plugin templates. Pass one of the results to CreatePlugin
to create a new plugin from that template.
tools.name: PluginToolset.PluginToolset.GetPluginTemplateDescriptions

name.description: Name of this template in the GUI

description.description: Description of this template in the GUI

onDiskPath.description: Path to the directory containing template files.

defaultTemplateName.description: Default plugin name. Typically a prefix.

bCanBePlacedInEngine.description: Whether or not this template can be used for Engine plugins

returnValue.description: Array of available plugin template descriptors.

tools.description:
Gets metadata for a discovered plugin, including description, version, base directory,
content directory, descriptor path, and mounted asset path.
tools.name: PluginToolset.PluginToolset.GetPluginInfo

tools.description:
Returns the name of the enabled plugin whose content mount point contains the given asset path.
Accepts full asset paths or mount point prefixes (e.g. /PluginName/ or /Game/Path/To/Asset).
tools.name: PluginToolset.PluginToolset.GetPluginForAsset

assetPath.description: The asset or mount point path to look up.

returnValue.description: The name of the plugin that owns the asset.

tools.description: Gets the editable descriptor fields for a discovered plugin.
tools.name: PluginToolset.PluginToolset.GetPluginDescriptor

returnValue.title: PluginDescriptorToolsetInfo
returnValue.description: The plugin's current editable descriptor fields.

category.description: The name of the category this plugin belongs to.

versionName.description:
Name of the version for this plugin. This is the front-facing part of the version number. It doesn't need to
match the version number numerically, but should be updated when the version number is increased accordingly.

version.description:
Version number for the plugin. The version number must increase with every version of the plugin, so that the
system can determine whether one version of a plugin is newer than another, or to enforce other requirements.
This version number is not displayed in front-facing UI. Use the VersionName for that.

createdBy.description: The company or individual who created this plugin. This is an optional field that may be displayed in the user interface.

createdByURL.description: Hyperlink URL string for the company or individual who created this plugin. This is optional.

marketplaceURL.description: Marketplace URL for this plugin. This URL will be embedded into projects that enable this plugin, so we can redirect to the marketplace if a user doesn't have it installed.

bIsBetaVersion.description: Marks the plugin as beta in the UI.

bIsExperimentalVersion.description: Marks the plugin as experimental in the UI.

bIsSealed.description: Prevents other plugins from depending on this plugin.

tools.description: Returns the names of all discovered plugins that declare a dependency on the given plugin.
tools.name: PluginToolset.PluginToolset.GetPluginDependents

pluginName.description: The name of the plugin to search for as a dependency target.

returnValue.description: Sorted array of plugin names that list the given plugin in their Plugins array.

tools.description: Returns the dependency entries from a plugin's Plugins array in its .uplugin file.
tools.name: PluginToolset.PluginToolset.GetPluginDependencies

bEnabled.description: Whether the dependency should be enabled.

returnValue.description: Array of dependency entries declared in the plugin's .uplugin file.

tools.description:
Creates a new plugin from a template and loads it into the editor.
Use GetPluginTemplateDescriptions to obtain a valid TemplateInfo.
tools.name: PluginToolset.PluginToolset.CreatePlugin

relativePluginLocation.description: Parent directory for the new plugin relative to template's default location. This should be empty unless you wish to specify a subdirectory.

bPlaceInEngine.description: Use Engine Plugins directory rather than Game Plugins directory location. Only some Templates allow placing in Engine. See the TemplateInfo's bCanBePlacedInEngine. This should be false unless explicitly requested by the user.

templateInfo.title: PluginTemplateDescriptionToolsetInfo
templateInfo.description: The plugin template to create from.

name.description: Name of this template in the GUI

description.description: Description of this template in the GUI

onDiskPath.description: Path to the directory containing template files.

defaultTemplateName.description: Default plugin name. Typically a prefix.

bCanBePlacedInEngine.description: Whether or not this template can be used for Engine plugins

description.description: A description for the new plugin.

returnValue.description: Created plugin's descriptor filename. Empty on failure.

tools.description:
Adds a dependency entry to a plugin's Plugins array in its .uplugin file.
No-ops if a dependency with that name already exists with matching settings.
The dependency plugin does not need to be currently discovered.
tools.name: PluginToolset.PluginToolset.AddPluginDependency

pluginName.description: The name of the plugin to modify.

dependencyName.description: The name of the plugin to add as a dependency.

bEnabled.description: Whether the dependency should be enabled.
